note: One model input for each of these games was NaN. The model was trained on rows with no NaN features, so XGBoost used its default branch for it. Found after logging; the ledger records are left as written. Later runs fill an undefined stat from the team's prior-season value (model/predict.py fill_missing_stat_values).

A second review the same day found two more train/serve gaps that these 15 records were scored with. (1) blowout_loss_diff was 0 for every game not yet played, so it missed the five games above, where one team had lost its Week 1 game by a blowout margin (CAR, CLE, DEN, IND, LA). (2) home_field_context_diff was set to a neutral 0.0 for all 15, because after one game every team has an undefined home or away point-differential split; training fills it from the prior season. Both are fixed in the repo (commit ea0d244) and apply to every prediction logged from the 2026-09-21 17:22Z run on. The records are left exactly as written. Two more things to know: the pick of record for NYG @ LA is this earlier record (report/grading use the earliest pre-kickoff snapshot); the later NYG @ LA snapshot (p_home 0.744 vs 0.766) was made with the fixes and picks the same side.
